newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Group Three spot low sulfur diesel and gasoline gained moderate ground Tuesday amid refiner buying interest and stronger NYMEX gasoline values, traders said.
"Gas remains relatively hot in the Group and low sulfur diesel is the talk in both the Group and Chicago," one trader said, adding supplies had been crimped by refinery problems in the Midwest.
"There was some good refiner buying of low sulfur in the Gulf yesterday," another trader said, keeping diesel firm in the Midcontinent.
